title: fix(rest): export boolean cells follow the caller's language
body:
Fixes #24945

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`GET /api/v1/data/:object/export` wrote every boolean or toggle cell as the literal `是` / `否`. The header row of the same file follows the caller's locale, so an `Accept-Language: en-US` caller got "Converted" and "Do Not Call" over Chinese cells. The cell now follows the same locale as the header.

- `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts`
  - `formatCellValue`, `formatRowCells` and `formatRowForJson` take `booleanWords` beside `timezone`. The boolean / toggle branch writes `booleanWords[0]` / `booleanWords[1]`.
  - The words have one source: `templateText(locale).booleanWords` in `import-template.ts`, the table the import template already uses (`yes` / `no`, or `是` / `否` for a `zh*` locale). The new `ExportBooleanWords` type is that table's own field type. No second table.
  - Without words, the formatter writes the pair `templateText(undefined)` answers (`yes` / `no`). That is the same answer the import template gives a request with no locale.
- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the export route
  - It resolves the request's i18n service once (`resolveI18nService`, then `extractLocale(req, i18n)`). That is the same read `answerImportTemplate` uses. It computes the words once per export from that locale.
  - It hands the same i18n service to `translateMetaItem` (its existing optional fifth argument). So the header translation and the words read one locale, from one service: `Accept-Language`, then `?locale=`, then the service's default locale.
  - csv, xlsx and json all pass the words through.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`. This file is outside the claimed file surface. See Deviations.
  - The `DataActionRouteHost` literal gains `resolveI18nService` and `extractLocale`. The route had no locale in hand: the header's locale was resolved inside `translateMetaItem` and never left it.
  - `rowsToCsv`, the csv arm's serializer, lives here. It takes `booleanWords` after `timezone` and passes them to `formatRowCells`.
- `packages/rest/src/import-template.ts`: one import line. `buildFieldMetaMap` / `ExportFieldMeta` now come from `@objectstack/core`, where they are defined, and no longer through `export-format.ts`'s re-export. `export-format.ts` now imports `templateText` from here, and this keeps the two modules from importing each other.
- No key, query parameter, accept set, header, column set or payload shape moves. Only the text of a boolean cell changes. The public declaration file gains nothing: in the built `dist/index.d.ts`, `booleanWords`, `ExportBooleanWords`, `templateText` and `rowsToCsv` each count 0 hits, and the control `ExportFieldMeta` counts 3.

## Readings on the mechanism assumptions

All readings come from the real export and import routes, on a real ObjectQL engine and protocol with a sqlite `:memory:` driver (`export-boolean-locale.test.ts`).

1. **Main writes `是` / `否` to an English caller, in every format.** At base `78ab6474ca`, an `en-US` csv export reads header `ID,Full Name,Converted,Do Not Call`, then row `1,Wren Halvorsen,是,否`. xlsx gives the same cells. json gives `"是"` / `"否"` as strings: the json arm runs the same branch through `formatRowForJson`, so it never kept raw `true` / `false`. With this PR, json writes the caller's words as strings. It does not switch to raw booleans, because that would move a payload shape.
2. **zh-CN and no locale.**
   - A `zh-CN` caller keeps `是` / `否`, under the Chinese header.
   - `templateText(undefined)` answers the English table, so a request with no locale gets `yes` / `no`.
   - The header with no locale is the authored label, untranslated. It agrees with the cells only when the labels are authored in English (the pinned fixture). A deployment whose i18n service declares a default locale resolves a header-less request to that default for both halves. This is pinned for a `zh-CN` default and for an `en` default.
3. **Re-import, both languages.** The importer (`IMPORT_BOOLEAN_TRUE_TOKENS` / `IMPORT_BOOLEAN_FALSE_TOKENS` in `packages/spec`) reads `yes` / `no` and `是` / `否`. Each language's csv and xlsx export, posted to `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` into a fresh store, reads back as `[true, false]` / `[false, true]`. All four pins are green.
4. **#2481 and #2916.** #2481 (the feature that added the formatter) lists "boolean: `是` / `否`" in its plan. It was written before the export resolved any locale, it has no comments, and its author is a contributor. #2916 made export and import follow the caller's language and does not mention booleans. Neither is a maintainer ruling that booleans are `是` / `否` for every locale.

## Evidence

- **Red on main.** At `d913467d6e`, which is the new test file alone on base `78ab6474ca`: `Tests  5 failed | 6 passed (11)`. The red pins are en csv, the xlsx pair, the json pair, the default-locale pin (its `en` half) and the no-i18n pin. The 6 green ones are the zh csv control, `?locale=zh-CN`, and the four re-import pins: main's `是` / `否` file re-imports.
- **Green.** `export-boolean-locale.test.ts`: `Tests  11 passed (11)`. The 11 affected export / import files: `Tests  620 passed (620)`.
- **Ablation A: the locale handed to the words.** It replaced `templateText(this.extractLocale(req, i18n)).booleanWords` with `templateText(undefined).booleanWords` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on `data-action-routes.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `53f7b7e9` → `5c3ec476`).
  - Result: `Tests  5 failed | 6 passed (11)`. Every zh pin went red: csv, the xlsx and json pairs, `?locale=`, and the default-locale pin.
  - The en pin stayed green. That is the direction the code predicts: with the locale dropped, the cells fall to `templateText(undefined)`, which is the English pair. So the en pin's red reading is the main-red above, not this ablation.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD `53f7b7e9`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Ablation B: one i18n service for both halves.** It replaced `this.extractLocale(req, i18n)` with `this.extractLocale(req, undefined)` (blob `53f7b7e9` → `8299404a`).
  - Result: `Tests  1 failed | 10 passed (11)`. The red pin is the default-locale one: a `zh-CN`-default deployment wrote the header `编号,姓名,已转化,请勿致电` over `yes` / `no` cells.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD `53f7b7e9`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Both ablations exercise this package's own `src/`, reached by relative import from the test. No `dist/` rebuild was needed.

## Fixture triage

The existing pins on `是` / `否` named no locale. Each was triaged by its fixture's language, so its header and cells keep one language:

- **Chinese fixtures now name a `zh-CN` caller.** These are `export-integration.test.ts`, `rest.test.ts`'s mocked export suite, and `import-template-route.test.ts`'s `exportOnce`.
  - The last of these holds the recorded export bytes (csv, json, xlsx by sha256), and it stays byte-identical with that caller.
  - So a Chinese caller's file is exactly what it was before this PR.
- **English fixture.** `export-json-fields.test.ts` (labels `ID` / `Title`, no locale) now expects `yes` / `no`.

## Gates (final head `3d3bafba28`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 68 commands. All 68 exited 0.
- The 10 families under "Declared WIDE population" also exited 0. These are `check:init-service-contract`, `live-db-isolation`, `meta-type-normalized`, `optional-error-sink`, `resume-authority-declared`, `runner-env-posture`, `settings-bind-window`, `startup-registry-verdict`, `verify-stand-in` and `wildcard-fallthrough`.
- The `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 68 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0, no findings printed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local`: `Test Files  307 passed (307)`, `Tests  6165 passed | 326 skipped (6491)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0. The test layer compiles the new file: `--listFiles` counts `export-boolean-locale.test.ts` once.
- An earlier head red `check:query-options-erasure` (test surface 236 → 238). The cause was two `as any` casts on the re-import pins' `engine.find` options. They are typed now, and the gate is green at the final head.

## Deviations

- **File surface.** The claim's surface did not list `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`. The fix needs it twice: once for the host wiring, because the route had no locale, and once for `rowsToCsv`, because the csv serializer lives there. The edits come to two host entries, one import name and the `rowsToCsv` parameter with its doc.

## Acceptance notes

- **No i18n service and no locale.** The cells read `yes` / `no` while the header shows the authored labels. A deployment with Chinese-authored labels, no i18n service and a header-less caller would show a Chinese header over English words. The import template behaves the same way in that case (`templateText(undefined)`). A deployment that registers the i18n service gets its default locale for both halves.
- **json carries strings.** json boolean cells are display strings (`"yes"` / `"是"`), as they were (`"是"`) before this PR. That is the formatting layer's existing design, unchanged here.
